acceptanceCriteria: A lock-free, non-mutating `pool status [--pool ID] [--member ID]` lists per member: state, allocation ID, holder/attempt/generation when allocated, quarantine reason and since-when, last health and cleanup outcome with timestamp.
help lists it among the reads; tests cover allocated, quarantined and idle members and the filters; a test proves it takes no lock and writes nothing.
